description: The collections of the corpus and the upstream sources they are built from.

$schema.description: The schema of this file, for an editor.

sources.description: The upstream sources, by name. A source is a submodule under sources/ with that name; its repository URL and commit are read from git.

collections.description: The collections, by name, in the order they are built. A collection is one dataset of a source, and its name is its folder in the corpus.

Name.description: The name of a source or of a collection, which is the name of a folder.

Forge.description: Where the source is hosted, which decides how the permanent link to one of its files is written.

LabelOrigin.description: Where the answers come from. by-construction: the pair was built so that the answer is known. witness-generator: the upstream authors' complete but timeout-bound tool, so an unlabelled case means that it gave up. upstream-tests: the expectations of the jsonsubschema tool's own tests.

UseCase.description: What the pairs of the collection are for.

SourceSpec.description: An upstream source: a submodule under sources/, at the commit it pins.

license.description: The SPDX identifier of the source's licence.

license_file.description: Where the text of the licence lives inside the source.

CollectionSpec.description: A collection: one dataset of a source.

source.description: The name of the source the collection is built from, one of those under sources.

path.description: Where the dataset lives inside the source.

description.description: What the collection holds, in a sentence or two.
